enchantments.tooltip: Diversion +14%: +14% Enhancement bonus to decreased threat generated from melee damage.
Deception +7: +7 Enhancement bonus to hit and +11 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Combat Mastery +7: +7 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
